note: The rich wave, step 2 of docs/art/RICH_STYLE_EXPERIMENT.md: today's small single-frame props redrawn from themselves at 64 px per tile (16 px today -> 64), in the shared ramps, style rich. All up to 64 art px, so the free route (DECISIONS 2026-10-22, drawing route by size): pnpm kit:gen tools/kit-gen/rich-props-small.json --drawer kaggle. Not here: the animated props (frames > 1: bushes, flowers, grass, herb plant, reeds, glow mushrooms, the lit campfire, the wolf), which wait for the motion layer (ART_SYSTEM section 4) so a single drawn frame never replaces a strip; fences and fence posts, which are thin and go to Codex by the same decision; fog, which is an effect. Each what + detail names shapes, materials and light, never pixel counts.
